products.name: Vidya AI
products.tagline: Offline-first Indian curriculum intelligence for schools and students
products.description: Vidya AI is an Indian-education intelligence engine built around NCERT, Maharashtra Board and NEP-oriented curriculum knowledge. It is designed to run locally or offline, with the internet used only for authentication, security and controlled updates. A mixture-of-experts layer routes text, document, speech, vision and assessment tasks to specialist experts behind a chat interface, and agents turn answers into actions.

products.name: Vidya Copilot
products.tagline: Teacher operating system for plans, papers and assessments
products.description: Vidya Copilot is a teacher-first AI that turns curriculum knowledge into annual, subject-wise, chapter-wise and daily teaching plans and automates recurring teacher work. Its product surface covers annual teaching plans, lesson plans, question papers, worksheets, assessment plans and remedial plans, and it is set to expand into parent communication and teacher analytics. products.name: Campus One
products.tagline: School operating ecosystem: fees, staff, payroll, academics, website
products.description: Campus One is a bundled school operating system that combines fee management, staff, payroll, attendance, report cards, inventory, real-time tracking, exam workflows and the school website. It lands with one operational module, expands to a 4-6 module bundle, then adds Vidya/Copilot and owns the school's digital identity. Once a school runs finance, attendance, payroll and academics on it, switching costs become operational rather than technical.

products.description: GTM Production OS is a sovereign application runtime: a production layer that turns AI-built and vibe-coded applications into deployable SaaS while reducing dependence on fragmented third-party services. It exposes reusable primitives (identity, billing adapters, mail, storage, vault, jobs) behind a stable internal runtime API, so applications can change providers without rewriting the product.
